Quote all HTML attribute values to avoid parsing ambiguity.
Enable Brotli (or at least gzip) compression for text assets on the server/CDN.
Serve images in a modern format (WebP or AVIF) for better compression.
Consider AVIF for the best image compression (alongside or instead of WebP).
